verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows that an API reference exists: the developer docs link to API endpoints at /reference. Nothing shows that the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, such as a try-it console or executable requests. The OpenAPI/Swagger spec paths all returned 404, so an existing static reference is adjacent to this story rather than the capability itself.
